title: GTA 6 The Album Rumored to Launch November 19th
description: Recent community leaks suggest GTA 6 The Album featuring 34 original tracks might launch on November 19th, with six debut singles now available.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 The Album Rumored to Launch November 19th with 34 Original Tracks

Excitement within the gaming and music communities has reached a new peak as fresh details regarding *Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album* surface online. According to recent discussions shared on the r/GTA6 Reddit community, this massive collection features 34 brand-new, original tracks curated from a diverse and genre-defying roster of top-tier global artists.

Please note that since this information originates from community submissions, it should currently be regarded as unconfirmed rumor pending official announcements from the publisher.

### Star-Studded Debut Singles

Alongside the album announcement details, six debut singles have been made available for streaming and listening across major platforms today:

- **Yung Lean** - "That's It" (feat. Future & Metro Boomin)
- **Travis Scott** - "RHYNO" (prod. by Guy-Manuel de Homem-Christo)
- **CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, Fred again.. & Etienne de Crécy** - "Sexy Magic"
- **Morgan Wallen** - "Last Thing You Need"
- **Rauw Alejandro** - "Macacoa 2000"
- **Keith Richards** - "Bright Lights, Big City"

### Pre-Save and Release Window

The community post highlights that *Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album* is currently available for pre-save on all major music streaming services. Furthermore, the tentative release date for the full 34-track collection is pointed toward **November 19th, 2026**.

Music has always been a cornerstone of the Grand Theft Auto franchise, defining the atmosphere and culture of its iconic virtual worlds. If these community-reported details hold true, players and music fans alike are in for an unprecedented auditory experience that bridges the gap between gaming and mainstream music culture.

## Editor's Take

While this leak originates from community sources and requires official verification, the sheer star power behind the initial single drops is undeniable. Music has always shaped the identity of the GTA universe. If a 34-track project is indeed dropping this November, it signals a massive multimedia rollout that will keep fans engaged well beyond the game's launch.
